description.value:
At 1st level, the sphereshaper selects a specific affinity in the nature of their mnemonic channeling known as their akashic adaptation. The available abilities are:

  • Attuned Affinity: The sphereshaper can select one mystic attunement from those available to viziers. The sphereshaper’s abilities to control external essence increase at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.
  • Diversified Affinities: At 1st level, the sphereshaper chooses a single veilweaving list besides sphereshaper and adds a veil from that list to their veil list. At 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level the sphereshaper adds an additional veil from the chosen class’s veil list to their own veil list.
  • Manabond Affinity: At 1st level, the sphereshaper gains a +1 competence bonus to their MSB when making concentration and spell penetration checks and to their MSD. This bonus increases by an additional +1 at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. The sphereshaper may invest this ability with essence, for each point invested in this ability the sphereshaper may select an ally within 60’. Each ally selected gains the benefits of this ability as well. Additionally, each of ally of your caster level or higher may, as an immediate action, sacrifice a spell point, prepared spell, or spell slot to grant the sphereshaper a temporary spell point for 1 minute per sphereshaper level. Sacrificed prepared spells and spell slots must be of a spell level equal to half your veilweaving level – 1 to grant a spell point. At 13th level spells above half your veilweaving level grant 2 spell points. The sphereshaper may use these spell points to cast talents from sphereshaper veils they currently have access to instead of essence binding.

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
